evals.prompt: I just created a new ProductRepository and ProductRepositoryImpl in my Flutter feature. How do I register it with GetIt + Injectable so it gets injected into my ProductBloc?
evals.expected_output: Shows @LazySingleton(as: ProductRepository) on ProductRepositoryImpl, @injectable on ProductBloc, getIt<ProductBloc>() in BlocProvider, and build_runner command to regenerate.

assertions.text: Response uses @LazySingleton(as: ProductRepository) annotation on the implementation class
Response uses @injectable annotation on the BLoC class
Response shows build_runner build command to regenerate injection.config.dart
Response shows getIt<ProductBloc>() usage inside BlocProvider in the UI

evals.prompt: I need to inject SharedPreferences and FlutterSecureStorage into my app. These are third-party types that don't have Injectable constructors. How do I register them with GetIt?
evals.expected_output: Shows @module abstract class with @preResolve for SharedPreferences and @lazySingleton for FlutterSecureStorage. Explains the module pattern for third-party types.

assertions.text: Response uses @module abstract class pattern for third-party registrations
Response uses @preResolve for SharedPreferences.getInstance() async initialization

evals.prompt: I have a multi-step checkout flow in Flutter and I need a CheckoutFlowController that's shared across 3 screens in the same flow, but disposed when the flow ends. How do I configure this in GetIt + Injectable?
evals.expected_output: Shows @Injectable(cache: true) for flow-scoped instances with getIt.releaseInstance() when flow ends. Explains the difference from @singleton.

assertions.text: Response uses @Injectable(cache: true) or mentions cached factory for flow-scoped instances
Response mentions getIt.releaseInstance() or equivalent cleanup when the flow ends
Response explains the difference between cached factory and singleton
